assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished landscape background for the default interactive mystery Last Light. Create a richly detailed, polished, hand-painted narrative game illustration, landscape 3:2 composition, ideally 1536x1024 or larger at the same aspect. Scene: inside a beautifully worn 1930s-style night train observation car, warm amber brass lamps, deep teal and forest-green velvet upholstery, dark walnut panels, rain-speckled broad windows and blue moonlit mountains outside. Camera seated eye level looking diagonally into the carriage, all key objects readable and spatially coherent. Main subjects: Mara, an expressive adult woman with an auburn bob, moss-green wool coat and mustard scarf, seated at the LEFT window with a pensive, approachable face and naturally drawn hands. Eli, an older male conductor with silver hair and a short silver beard, navy uniform, brass buttons and peaked cap, stands on the RIGHT near the door holding a small pocket watch. Both are substantial illustrated characters with natural anatomy, painterly fabric and expressive faces, never polygonal, faceless, or simplistic. Foreground center-left: a small walnut table between the player and Mara, with ONE clearly visible worn postcard-sized photograph turned FACE DOWN (blank ivory back, no handwriting), resting unobstructed next to one ceramic cup; table edge and photograph clearly separated so the photo can be clicked. In the MID-RIGHT of the composition, place a prominent real vintage wooden radio on a small fixed walnut shelf beside Eli, with curved wooden case, fabric speaker grille, amber tuning dial and two round knobs. Clearly show the radio as an actual solid object in the scene, not a label. A red emergency-brake handle hangs on the door frame on the far right. Preserve generous clearly shaped windows with blue night landscape behind Mara and toward the back; keep their glass panes large and their borders sharp so they can later receive clipped moving landscape overlays. Fine details: luggage racks, one leather suitcase, brass fasteners, velvet seams, soft lamp reflections, tea steam, rain on glass. Coherent perspective, believable train architecture and object scale, cinematic warm/cool lighting. Readable medium contrast, rich but not overly dark. Full-bleed finished artwork, no UI, no floating labels, no text, no logos, no watermark. The radio, face-down photograph, both characters, and brake must all be visible and unobstructed.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: the actual photograph a player opens in the Last Light mystery. Input image 1 is a CHARACTER AND WORLD REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create a new landscape 3:2 vintage color photograph with a narrow worn ivory paper border. It shows THREE people standing close together on a sunlit mountain railway platform: Mara from the reference, with the same expressive face, auburn bob, moss green coat and mustard scarf; Eli from the reference, the same silver-haired older conductor with short silver beard, navy uniform and brass-buttoned cap; and the player, an androgynous young adult with short dark hair and a simple cream traveling jacket. Their expressions are warm, relaxed, and quietly happy, as if they once knew each other well. Eli has one arm casually around the player's shoulder, Mara holds the player's hand. The people should be recognizable as the same Mara and Eli from image 1. Behind them: the same elegant dark-green train, period station canopy, hazy mountains, pale golden morning light, a station clock. Fine film grain, slightly faded amber and teal color, intimate believable old travel photograph, coherent hands and natural anatomy, detailed faces. Only these three people. No collage, no floating props, no UI, no watermark, no readable signs or text; the handwritten message will be added on the reverse by the app. This is the full photograph viewed straight on, not a picture of a photograph lying on a table.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Make exactly one small localized change: REMOVE the single face-down ivory photograph from the foreground walnut table, and seamlessly reconstruct the uninterrupted dark walnut tabletop and its warm lamp reflections underneath. Preserve the cup, table, Mara's face and pose, Eli's face and pose, radio, brake handle, lamps, all windows, scenery, framing, resolution, perspective, colors and lighting EXACTLY. No new objects, no crop, no reframing, no stylistic changes. This is the identical game frame after the player has picked up the photograph; every other element must stay aligned.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ending landscape illustration for the Last Light default train adventure. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND TRAIN DESIGN REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create a new full-bleed landscape 3:2 image, 1536x1024. The first quiet mountain railway platform after a long night. The same elegant vintage dark-green and walnut train from the reference is now stopped on the RIGHT, a warmly glowing open carriage door and brass handrails visible nearby. The viewer has just stepped onto a slightly rain-wet stone platform. On the LEFT a lovingly worn railway shelter with iron pillars, amber lamps, an empty wooden bench, climbing plants and an old round clock. Farther away, tracks curve into blue mountains and drifting low mist beneath a pale golden sunrise. Rich, detailed, cinematic painterly illustration with natural materials, soft atmospheric depth, morning reflections and a moving, hopeful sense of arrival. Match the reference's amber/teal palette, period, level of detail and coherent perspective; morning is warmer and brighter. No visible people in frame: the player and any companion are standing just outside the camera view, so this art can support either a solitary or a shared ending. No photograph, no UI, no floating text, no signage text, no watermark. Preserve readable highlights and shadow detail.
